281. (Currently amended) A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and at least two adhesive layers, the tool comprising first and second layers, a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on the first layer, a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on the second layer, the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer configured to be cured to each other, the tool __having__ a circular shape and __further comprising__ a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, and a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer, __and further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the outer perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments, wherein the plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring, and wherein the weld ring is segmented.__

282. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

283. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

284. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section is a composite material.

285. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the tool further comprises an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

286. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening.

287. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the inner ring comprises a metal.

288. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the inner ring is steel.

289. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the segmented weld ring comprises a plurality of circumferentially spaced ring segments.

290. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the medial section is bonded to the inner ring.

291. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening for accommodating a drive shaft.

293. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the first layer and the second layer are steel outer blade cores.

294. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 293 wherein the medial section is a honeycomb material.

295. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 293 wherein the segmented weld ring comprises a plurality of circumferentially spaced ring segments.
